verses.ar:
Sare nabian da nabi tu imam soniya
Rakha tere te Durood te Salam soniya
verses.en:
Prophet of all prophets, you are the leader, O beautiful one
We send upon you Durood and Salam, O beautiful one

verses.ar:
Taazeem se leta hai khuda naam e Muhammed
Kiya naam hai ae Salle Ala naam e Muhammed
Allah kare us pe haram aatish e dozakh
Jis shakhs ke ho dil pe likha naam e Muhammed
verses.en:
God takes the name of Muhammad with the utmost reverence
What a name it is — O Sallallahu Alayhi Wa Sallam — the name of Muhammad
May God forbid the fire of Hell for that person
On whose heart the name of Muhammad is written

verses.ar:
Kamli waliya tere karam bayon buha rehamatan da kadi khulda naii
Teri galli de kharaan vich maza jera o te maza firdos de phul da naii
Kainaat de takhta cho takht koi teri paak chatai te tulda naii
Takht ki ae Arsh e Azam tere jore di khaakh te mulda naii
verses.en:
O master of the black shawl, the door of your mercy never closes
The pleasure found in the thorns of your lane surpasses the flowers of paradise
No throne in all creation can be compared to your pure mat
What is the Mighty Throne? — it kneels before the dust at your feet

verses.ar:
Teriya thumaan to ajab duniya
Teriya jutian arsh ne chumiyan
verses.en:
From your resting place, what a wondrous world opens
The Throne itself kissed your blessed sandals

verses.ar:
Duniya te aaya koi teri na misaal da
Rasool aur bhi aaye jahan mai laiken
Koi teri na misaal da
Yun to Isaa bhi hain, Musa bhi hain, Yusuf bhi magar
Koi teri na misaal da
verses.en:
No one who came into this world has your equal
Other Prophets also came into the world — but
None has your equal
True — Isa is there, Musa is there, Yusuf too — but
None has your equal

verses.ar:
Tujh sa haseen nahin, na hi teri Misaal hai
Tera jamaal ain khuda ka jamaal hai
Koi teri na misaal da
verses.en:
There is none as beautiful as you, and none to equal you
Your beauty is the very beauty of God made manifest
None has your equal

verses.ar:
Aam hain rehmatain zamaane par rehmaton ka koi hisaab nahin
Tere qurbaan ya Rasoolullah tera qonain mai jawab nahin
Mere sonhe kamli wa larriya, tera aashiq kul zamana hai
Tere husan di ki tareef karan, rab aap tera deewana hai
verses.en:
Mercies are common in the world but there is no counting of yours
I sacrifice myself for you, O Messenger of God — you have no equal in both worlds
O my beautiful master of the black shawl, all of creation is your lover
How can I praise your beauty — God Himself is devoted to you

verses.ar:
Chehra tera noor wande sari kainaar nu
Rab wi Durood bheje ik teri zaat nu
verses.en:
Your face distributes its light to the entire universe
Even God sends Durood upon your blessed being

verses.ar:
Jis ne dekhe nain matwale tere
Mast o bekhud wo na ho to kiya kare
Ik nazar jo dekh lai to kehta phire
Har har kundal kundal uthe aashiq da dil bole
Husn tere do sift ki akha kafir kalma bole
verses.en:
Whoever has seen your intoxicating eyes
How can they not become lost and overwhelmed?
Whoever catches a single glance goes about proclaiming
On every lock of your hair the lover's heart cries out
In praise of your beauty even the disbeliever utters the Kalima

verses.ar:
Roya shab e hijran mai bohot ashk bahaayai
Itne mein Musavir ko zara reham jo aaya
Naqshi gayi tasveeron ko wo saamne laaya
Bola ke ye Yusuf hain, ye Isaa hain ye Musa
Main ne kaha in mein se kisi par nahin sheda
Jab saamne laya ba shabih e Shah e wala
verses.en:
I wept much in the nights of separation, shedding many tears
When at last the Painter took some pity on me
He brought forward portraits he had painted
Saying: this is Yusuf, this is Isa, this is Musa
I said: I am not devoted to any of these
Then he brought forward the likeness of the noble Shah

verses.ar:
Be sakhta us waqt zaban se meri nikala
Mukh chand badr shah shani ae
Kali zulf ter akh mastani ae
Makhmoor akhi in madhbarian
Teri soorat nu main jaan aakha
Jaan aakhe jaan jahan aakha
Sach aakha te Rab di shaan aakha
Jes shaan to shaanaan sab baniyaan
Subhanallah
Ma Ajamalakah
Ma Ahsanakah
Ma Akamalakah
verses.en:
At that very moment these words left my lips unbidden:
Your face is like the full moon, O king of beauty
Your dark tresses, your intoxicating eyes
Your heavy-lidded eyes, those worshippers of God
I called your face my very life
Called it life — called it the life of the world
I spoke truth and spoke of God's own glory
From whose glory all glories are born
Subhanallah — Glory be to God
How beautiful You are
How fine You are
How perfect You are

verses.ar:
Tere sadqe jahan sara paya baniyan, tere waaste Quran sara baniyan
Paya tere jiya kise na maqam soniya rakha tere te Durood te Salam soniya
Tenu arshaa te Rab ne bulaaiya ai, shaan tere jiya hon kinne paya ai
Poori Rab naal teri ae kalam soniya rakha tere te Durood te Salam soniya
verses.en:
For your sake the entire world was created, for you the entire Quran was revealed
No one has attained a station like yours, O beautiful one — we send upon you Durood and Salam
God called you to the Throne, who else has attained a glory like yours?
Your conversation with God was complete, O beautiful one — we send upon you Durood and Salam
